scientific_limitations: Exact Pareto renewal intervals with lower cutoff one, Brownian generator \(D\partial_{xx}\), independent full resets and \(\alpha>2\). title: A sharp Gaussian–logarithmic–stable trichotomy for renewal-reset quadratic occupation
